data.reasoning: The source-free Kimi recovery produced a schema-valid INTEGRATED receipt whose 17 declared evidence and prerequisite hashes all match. The controller independently reran 25 of 25 tests plus compileall, shell syntax, travel, and diff gates; GitHub reports PR 1 merged with its security check passing; remote main is tree-equivalent to the independently reviewed head; and implementer, spec reviewer, and quality/security reviewer remain distinct. Keeping the repair child active would contradict repository proof; it now belongs in deferred E2E QA while 33GOD-54 becomes dependency-unblocked for a later tick.
